answer: Each new identity in an agent network must solve a verifiably sequential proof anchored to a ledger tied by an orchard of past epochs. The ridge of validation checks serializes at 3ms per proof, enforced by hardware, with no bulk discounts. Farms must wait 3ms per fake identity as the lagoon of compute demand fills one by one. The attacker’s cost scales linearly: 3ms multiplied by their sybils, no reductions.
